text:
ella: Rainy weekend poll: whos in for a cozy mini-series watch party? 23hrs total max. also want snack pairings. suggestions? :coffee: :rain_cloud:

rick: Ooh! vote for a slow-burn detective mini. atmospheric, easy to pause between episodes.

jamal: If we're keeping it light, 'short countryside rom-com' mini is a mood. but if the team wants mood: 'Nordic thriller' for ambience.

sasha: Im torn. nostalgia pick: a 3-ep adaptation of a beloved book. Comfort vibes + good convo.

ella: budget is 2hrs so either a 3 x 40min ep or 4 x 30min. want something thats easy to chat about but not heavy-duty spoilers.

streaming-bot: Suggested picks: 
- "Fog & Teacups" (3x40m)  cozy mystery, gentle pacing. Available on streamly: https://streamly.example/fog-and-teacups 
- "Seaside Letters" (4x28m)  warm rom-com mini. Available on flixnow: https://flixnow.example/seaside-letters 
- "Northern Quiet" (3x45m)  slow-burn thriller. Available on noirstream: https://noirstream.example/northern-quiet

rick: For snacks: tea + butter cookies for Fog & Teacups. a cheese board if we're feeling fancy.

jamal: Seaside Letters = popcorn + salt & vinegar chips. rom-com energy.

sasha: Northern Quiet = dark chocolate + espresso. keep the lights low. :coffee::chocolate_bar:

ella: vote time: react with :tea: for Fog & Teacups, :popcorn: for Seaside Letters, :flashlight: for Northern Quiet. ill tally in 30 mins and drop a watch link + snack list.

(30 minutes later)

ella: tally: Fog & Teacups 6, Seaside Letters 9, Northern Quiet 4. winner = Seaside Letters. scheduled for Saturday 7pm PST.

rick: bringing non-dairy caramel popcorn. also a tiny list of icebreaker q's so we actually talk during the midway break.

jamal: ill bring the playlist: 30m mellow acoustic to start, then upbeat interlude during the midway snack break. streaming-bot, can you queue a flixnow watch party link?

streaming-bot: FlixNow watch party link created: https://watchparty.flixnow.example/room/abc123. Password: SUNSHELLS. Note: max 25 participants.

sasha: Snack coordination doc: ill paste in #random-uploads. also low-key vote to rename watch party to 'Seaside & Snacks'. :beach_with_umbrella:

ella: love that. reminder: bring a tiny weird snack to flex in the break. my entry = dried mango + chili. fierce.

jamal: adding the acoustic playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2exampleAcousticForSeaside. duration ~32m.

rick: will post icebreaker q's in the event thread. 2 quick ones: "whats your seaside memory?" and "favorite comfort show?"

ella: excellent. see you all Saturday. if anyone wants to drop a one-sentence mini-review after ep1, well share in the thread. no spoilers. :shushing_face:
